# logos nogo for loGo/s packages: ejected-Go findings map to the original
# .lgo path, //logos:allow scope, warn/deny/forbid, and --json-diagnostics.
# Helper is $GOROOT/lib/logos-nogo; behavior only, no registry count.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

# printf in .lgo fails at the original .lgo line, never the eject temp.
# The call goes through a local formatf wrapper: the native check covers std
# printf calls only, so logos build stays clean while nogo flags the wrapper.
cd lgoprintf
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'eject'
! exists lgoprintf
! exists lgoprintf$GOEXE
# logos build runs compiler lints only, no nogo.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgoprintf$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cd ..

# checklocks in .lgo maps to the original .lgo line.
cd lgolocks
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:12:.*\[nogo::checklocks\]'
! stderr 'eject'
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgolocks$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cd ..

# SA5001 in .lgo.
cd lgosa
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:7:.*\[nogo::sa5001\]'
! stderr 'eject'
cd ..

# //logos:allow silences printf at deny in .lgo.
cd lgoallowed
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# nogo = "warn" in .lgo prints with warning prefix and exits 0.
cd lgowarn
logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:.*warning: \[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'eject'
cd ..

# nogo = "forbid" in .lgo stays forbid: fails without warning prefix.
cd lgoforbid
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
cd ..

# Allow on a forbid rule in .lgo is itself an error plus the rule.
cd lgoforbidallowed
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:.*\[correctness::allow_forbidden_rule\]'
stderr 'main\.lgo:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
cd ..

# --json-diagnostics for .lgo names the original .lgo file with schema 1.0.
cd lgoprintf
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*\}$'
stderr '"schema_version":"1\.0"'
stderr '"rule_id":"nogo::printf"'
stderr '"severity":"deny"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*main\.lgo"'
stderr '"span":\{"start_line":6,'
stderr '"provenance":'
stderr '"autofix_candidates":\[\]'
! stderr '^#'
! stderr 'eject'
cd ..

# Warn severity in JSON for .lgo exits 0.
cd lgowarn
logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*\}$'
stderr '"rule_id":"nogo::printf"'
stderr '"severity":"warn"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*main\.lgo"'
! stderr '^#'
cd ..

# Forbid severity in JSON for .lgo stays forbid.
cd lgoforbid
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr '"rule_id":"nogo::printf"'
stderr '"severity":"forbid"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*main\.lgo"'
cd ..

# A user //line directive remaps adjusted positions: findings still key by
# the physical file and report at physical original lines, an allow above
# the directive still silences the statement below it, and the build does
# not abort on the remapped name.
cd lgoline
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgoline$GOEXE .
! stderr .
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:9:(18|19|20): \[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'main\.lgo:8:'
! stderr 'virtual'
! stderr 'outside eject'
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*\}$'
stderr '"rule_id":"nogo::printf"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*main\.lgo"'
stderr '"span":\{"start_line":9,'
! stderr 'virtual'
cd ..

# A finding inside a rewritten ? operand maps to its exact original
# coordinates: the earlier rewrite shifts lowered lines, and the last
# function ends at the file end, before the generated trailer. Exactly the
# two user violations print, with no generated-only duplicate.
cd lgoquestion
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgoquestion$GOEXE .
! stderr .
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:10:(12|13|14): \[nogo::printf\]'
stderr 'main\.lgo:15:(12|13|14): \[nogo::printf\]'
stderr -count=2 '\[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr '_logos'
! stderr 'eject'
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr -count=2 '^\{.*\}$'
stderr '"rule_id":"nogo::printf"'
stderr '"file":"[^"]*main\.lgo"'
stderr '"span":\{"start_line":10,'
stderr '"span":\{"start_line":15,'
! stderr 'eject'
cd ..

# Findings inside rewritten chain lambdas (an expression lambda, a ?
# lambda, a block lambda) and a ? after them map to their exact original
# coordinates. Exactly the four user violations print: generated-only
# diagnostics stay excluded while every nearby user diagnostic is kept.
cd lgochain
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:21:(28|29|30): \[nogo::printf\]'
stderr 'main\.lgo:22:20: \[nogo::printf\]'
stderr 'main\.lgo:24:(16|17|18): \[nogo::printf\]'
stderr 'main\.lgo:28:(16|17): \[nogo::printf\]'
stderr -count=4 '\[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr '_logos'
! stderr 'eject'
cd ..

# An allow inside a replaced span still silences at original coordinates:
# the directive covers the statement on its next code line only, so the
# violation above it still fails.
cd lgoallowspan
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:11:(16|17|18): \[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'main\.lgo:13:'
stderr -count=1 '\[nogo::printf\]'
cd ..

# Under forbid an allow inside a replaced span is itself an error at its
# original location, and the finding it names still fails.
cd lgoforbidspan
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:11:3: \[correctness::allow_forbidden_rule\] //logos:allow\(nogo::printf\) forbids a forbid rule'
stderr 'main\.lgo:12:(16|17|18): \[nogo::printf\]'
! stderr 'warning:'
cd ..

# Plain go has no lint command and no --json-diagnostics flag.
cd lgoprintf
! go lint ./...
stderr 'unknown command'
! go build --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr 'flag provided but not defined: -json-diagnostics'
cd ..

-- lgoprintf/go.mod --
module example.com/lgoprintf

go 1.27

-- lgoprintf/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	println(formatf("%d", "hello"))
}

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

-- lgolocks/go.mod --
module example.com/lgolocks

go 1.27

-- lgolocks/main.lgo --
package main

import "sync"

type Guarded struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	// +checklocks:mu
	val int
}

func (g *Guarded) Set(v int) {
	g.val = v
}

func (g *Guarded) SetLocked(v int) {
	g.mu.Lock()
	defer g.mu.Unlock()
	g.val = v
}

func main() {
	g := &Guarded{}
	g.Set(1)
}

-- lgosa/go.mod --
module example.com/lgosa

go 1.27

-- lgosa/main.lgo --
package main

import "os"

func open(p string) (*os.File, error) {
	f, err := os.Open(p)
	defer f.Close()
	if err != nil {
		return f, err
	}
	return f, nil
}

func main() {
	f, err := open("x")
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	defer f.Close()
}

-- lgoline/go.mod --
module example.com/lgoline

go 1.27

-- lgoline/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	//logos:allow(nogo::printf)
	//line virtual.go:100
	println(formatf("%d", "hello"))
	println(formatf("%d", "hello"))
}

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

-- lgoquestion/go.mod --
module example.com/lgoquestion

go 1.27

-- lgoquestion/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func logf(format string, args ...any) (string, error) {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...), nil
}

func first() (string, error) {
	a := logf("%d", "hello")?
	return a, nil
}

func last() (string, error) {
	b := logf("%d", "hello")?
	return b, nil
}

func main() {
	x, err := first()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	y, err := last()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	println(x, y)
}

-- lgochain/go.mod --
module example.com/lgochain

go 1.27

-- lgochain/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

func logf(format string, args ...any) (string, error) {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...), nil
}

func parse(x int) (int, error) {
	if x < 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("neg")
	}
	return 2 * x, nil
}

func run(xs []int) (string, error) {
	ex := xs.map(x => formatf("%d", "hello"))
	ys := xs.map(x => logf("%d", x, xs)?)
	zs := xs.map(x => {
		t := formatf("%d", "bad")
		return t
	})
	tot := len(ex) + len(ys) + len(zs)
	s := logf("%d %d", tot)?
	return s, nil
}

func main() {
	s, err := run([]int{1, 2, 3})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	println(s)
}

-- lgoallowspan/go.mod --
module example.com/lgoallowspan

go 1.27

-- lgoallowspan/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

func main() {
	_ = []int{1, 2}.map(x => {
		t := formatf("%d", "bad")
		//logos:allow(nogo::printf)
		u := formatf("%d", "bad")
		return t + u
	})
}

-- lgoforbidspan/go.mod --
module example.com/lgoforbidspan

go 1.27

-- lgoforbidspan/logos.toml --
[lints]
nogo = "forbid"

-- lgoforbidspan/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func formatf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

func main() {
	_ = []int{1, 2}.map(x => {
		//logos:allow(nogo::printf)
		t := formatf("%d", "bad")
		return t
	})
}
